thread:
Nina: quick sync — int3 int3-int3 quant bring-up shows solid perf but we have a concentrated deid failure cluster for CJK + Arabic long-contexts. Opening thread to align sampling, dedupe, and a potential routing fallback.

Ravi: can you paste a failing example? tokenization issue or model answer change?

Nina: mostly redaction misses due to token-boundary splits and unicode normalization differences. example (sanitized):
```
prompt: "Redact names and phones from transcript"
baseline: "[REDACTED] 电话: [REDACTED]"
int3: "李 小 电话: 123-XXX-XXXX"  # split introduced a space -> redact missed
```

Marta: dataset note — our fingerprinting runs pre-normalize. propose change: canonicalize (NFC + remove zwj/zwsp + normalize bidi) before fuzzyhash. That should surface duplicates across translit/spacing variants.

Eun: I'll run tokenizer parity on a 3k lang-mix sample (zh, ja, ko, ar, he). plan: `tools/tokenizer_diff.py --baseline quant4b --candidate int3 --langs zh,ja,ko,ar,he --sample 3000` — ETA 5h.

LabelOpsBot: backlog=102, active=28. recommended micro-golden=1500 lang-balanced. can create project once sample CSV pushed.

Sam: For labels, add checkbox schema: [normalization_issue, redact_missed, hallucination, truncation]. Also include metadata fields: `script`, `translit_method`, `needs_canonical_review`.

Marta: will generate 1500 sample with lang splits (zh400, ja200, ko150, ar300, he100, ru150, other200), include 250 synthetic transliterations and 200 spacing-variant paraphrases. will canonicalize before dedupe and report collision counts.

Ravi: good. If tokenizer diffs show boundary shifts >2% on long contexts we should hold the roll for deid traffic. @DeployBot can you stand up a temporary route to fallback quant4b for affected langs+ctx?

DeployBot: Can create rule: route requests where deid=true AND lang IN (zh,ja,ko,ar,he) AND ctx_tokens>512 -> quant4b-fallback. Will create canary route and hold for manual flip.

Eun: early token-diff sneak peek: most diffs at punctuation+emoji boundaries and ZWJ sequences. will post full diff + examples in 4-5h.

Nina: timeline: Marta push sample and synthetic by EOD, LabelOpsBot create project and spin label jobs, Eun posts tokenizer report, Sam will assemble canary eval metrics (per-lang PR + normalization-adjusted recall). decision checkpoint Tue midday.

LabelOpsBot: project `int3-multilang-deid-mini` created (tasks=1500, SLA=36h, est_completion=48h).

Marta: pushing CSV to /label-ops now (link omitted). remember to mark items which look like normalization artifacts so we can separate signal.

Sam: will add normalization-adjusted metric to dashboard and weight failures by user-impact. posting eval stub when ready. :mag:

Nina: thanks all. ping here with tokenizer diffs or if anyone sees additional edge cases (zero-width/chinese punctuation variants).

Eun: posting diffs in ~4h.
